posts.title: Apple Obsolescence
posts.description: I despise Apple. But I didn’t know how much. As I am forced agreed to switch to a Mac laptop for a new job, I dusted off a MacBook bought from work a couple of years ago to practice and ease into the system. That’s when I learned that Apple have dropped Intel x86_64 support in their upcoming major version of macOS. 😳😶😬😠😡

posts.title: Secret Chemnitz
posts.description: Two weeks ago I met someone at a local pub who pitched a visit tour by bike in Chemnitz, titled Secret Chemnitz , scheduled on the next weekend. Chemnitz not being particularly known as a touristy destination 1 , I was intrigued and decided to go. Actually 2 friends came along and that was a fascinating journey.
